name: Clock
description: Every 1.2s, reliably, and it hits hard because it is so rare. The metronome everything else is measured against.

name: On Hit
description: Whenever your effects damage an enemy. Constant — measured at 188 a second — so each one is worth a fraction.

name: On Kill
description: Whenever an enemy dies to your effects. The classic cascade seed.

name: On Pickup
description: Whenever you collect XP. Turns movement into firepower, and a Magnet into a barrage.

name: On Crit
description: When a hit crits. Rare, so it hits x3. Scales hard with crit chance.

name: On Dash
description: When you dash. x20 on a 3s cooldown — mobility as a weapon.

name: On Wound
description: When you take damage. Rare and unwanted, so it pays x40. Pairs with Leech.

name: On Wave
description: When a new composition arrives. Once or twice a minute, x50. The burst archetype.

name: On Overheat
description: When Heat hits 100. x60 — weaponises the penalty. Build around it.

name: On Convert
description: When a conversion resolves. x6 — the economy-engine payoff.
